title: Classic Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious classic chicken stir fry loaded with colorful vegetables and a savory sauce.
instructions: Slice 300g chicken breast into thin strips and season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the seasoned chicken strips and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently until golden and cooked through.
Stir in 2 cloves minced garlic and 1 tsp minced ginger, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 1 sliced bell pepper, 200g broccoli florets, and 1 julienned carrot, and stir-fry for 5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Mix together 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1/4 cup water in a bowl, then pour over the stir fry and cook for another 2-3 minutes to thicken.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot over rice or noodles.

title: Spicy Mango Chicken Stir Fry
description: A vibrant and spicy mango chicken stir fry that combines sweetness with heat for a delightful dinner.
instructions: Slice 300g chicken breast into strips and season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until nearly cooked through and starting to brown.
Stir in 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp minced ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 1 sliced bell pepper, 100g snap peas, and 1 sliced onion, stir-frying for another 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Mix together 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sriracha, 1 tbsp lime juice, and 1 tbsp cornstarch with 1/4 cup (60ml) water, then pour over the stir fry.
Add 1 diced mango to the stir fry, mixing well and cooking for another 2 minutes until heated through.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve over jasmine rice or quinoa.

title: Thai Basil Chicken Stir Fry
description: A fragrant Thai basil chicken stir fry that brings aromatic flavors and a hint of spice to your meal.
instructions: Slice 300g chicken breast into thin strips and season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until hot.
Add the sliced chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 2 chopped thai chilies, and 1 sliced onion, stir-frying for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in 1 sliced bell pepper, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp sugar, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup loosely packed thai basil to the stir fry, mixing well until the basil has wilted.
Serve hot with rice or noodles and garnish with extra thai basil if desired.
